about: The first part a new language translates (docs/LANGUAGES.md, "Partial languages"): the login screen, the desktop, Files, the installer, About, the app names, the file dialogs, and Settings' sections, Language & Region and the Date & Time formats. Each namespace is the whole assets/locales/en/<namespace>.json, or only the keys listed (a key, or a prefix ending in a dot). node tools/i18n-check.mjs prints a partial language's coverage of it.
